delivery failure or package held for payment

kill_chain_signals.contact: fraudsters send unsolicited text messages or emails impersonating shipping companies, call claiming to be service providers, reach out through random wrong number text messages, send fake text messages about toll fees
kill_chain_signals.pretext: urgent requests for personal or payment information due to incomplete shipping, offering new cellphone and discounted plan, promoting crypto investment opportunities with guaranteed profits, online romance followed by requests for money, claiming ability to recover previous fraud losses, soliciting charity donations, notifying of prize or vacation winnings
kill_chain_signals.payment: request payment to fabricated shipping company, collect personal information for credit checks and order phone in victim's name, assist in setting up investment accounts with small initial investment, countless requests for money from romance interest, collecting money through reindeer games from recovery offers, requesting gift cards as payments under pressure, requiring fees to claim prize winnings
kill_chain_signals.movement: phone may be shipped directly to fraudsters or victim receives wrong phone and is requested to ship it forward
kill_chain_signals.cashout: fraudsters use victim's information and money for shopping spree

unsolicited messages urgently requesting personal or payment information
